## BED BUGS (HEMIPTERA)
Antimicrobial treatment is not indicated. Treat itching with topical
corticosteroids or systemic antihistamines.
## Inpatient

[Triamcinolone 0.1% cream apply to affected area BID PRN for itching ($)[M]](psjzid-triamcinolone-0-1-crm-top-bid-prn)
[Hydroxyzine pamoate 25 mg PO TID until symptoms resolve, then take 25 mg PO](psjzid-hydroxyzine-pamoate-25mg-po-tid)
TID PRN for itching ($) [H]
